source.citation: Lignet F, Becker AD, Gimmi C, Rohdich F, El Bawab S. Using thrombocytopenia modeling to investigate the mechanisms underlying platelet depletion induced by pan-proteasome inhibitors. CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol. 2022;11(5):594-603.
source.storage: Source files are kept on the platform owner's computer only; they are not committed.
source.funding_and_interests: No funding; authors employed by Merck KGaA at the time.
source.extraction: AI-assisted transcription from the PDF text layer and supplement XML; independent review pending.

data_behind_the_model.platelets: Mean platelet counts digitised from published graphs (Lonial et al. 2005, ref 7); no individual data for bortezomib.
data_behind_the_model.pk: Mean concentration profiles from Reece et al. 2011 (12 patients, days 1 and 11 of cycles 1 and 3) used only for graphical comparison.
data_behind_the_model.regimen: 1.3 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 4, 8 and 11 of 21-day cycles, up to 8 cycles
data_behind_the_model.population: Relapsed multiple myeloma (SUMMIT/CREST); 55-57% men; median age 59-62
data_behind_the_model.between_patient_variability: Not estimated for bortezomib (mean data only). Outputs can only be typical values.

pk_model.origin: Hanley et al. 2017 pediatric population PK (Table S1), scaled to adults: P_adult = P_pediatric x (BSA_adult / BSA_pediatric)^b with b = 1, BSA_pediatric = 1.30 m2, BSA_adult = 1.62 m2 (article Methods; Table 1)

pediatric_source_values.location: Table S1 (population medians; Hanley et al. 2017)

pk_model.scaling_check: Each Table 1 value equals the pediatric value / 1.30 x (1.62 / 1.30) to rounding (tested). The per-m2 values are therefore multiplied by the adult BSA (1.62 m2 in the source) to obtain L or L/h.
pk_model.location: Table 1; Methods 'PK model development and analysis'; Supplementary Information S1

pd_model.structure: Semi-mechanistic thrombocytopenia model: proliferating progenitors (Prol), three transit compartments (Trans1-3), circulating platelets (Circ); feedback (Circ0/Circ)^gamma on proliferation (Friberg 2002; Bender 2012; Tsuji 2017; Collins 2017)

myelosuppression.description: Drug slows division of progenitor cells (Eq 6).

platelet_budding.description: Drug slows release of new platelets from megakaryocytes (Eqs 7-8).

pd_model.parameter_location: Table 2 (bortezomib columns); values are estimates with coefficient of variation (%)

model_comparison_in_source.statistical_reading: For bortezomib the platelet-budding variant has the lower -2LL, AIC and BIC.
model_comparison_in_source.text_reading: Discussion: 'the model with myelosuppression better describes the data' and the budding model 'could be more biologically relevant'. The statement matches Table S2 for ixazomib and carfilzomib, not for bortezomib.
model_comparison_in_source.plausibility: Budding MTT 846 h is about sixfold above the highest published platelet MTT (134 h); myelosuppression parameters lie within or near published ranges (gamma 0.38 slightly above 0.29).
model_comparison_in_source.mechanistic_evidence: In-vitro and clinical work (Lonial 2005; Murai 2014) points to impaired platelet budding rather than suppressed progenitor proliferation.
model_comparison_in_source.platform_decision: Implement both variants side by side, each labelled with its fit, plausibility and mechanism evidence. Neither is called correct.

open_questions.question: Units of C in the drug-effect term (1 - slope*C).
open_questions.evidence: Never stated for the PD equations. PK figures are labelled ng/mL. nM would rescale the effect by 2.6.
open_questions.resolution: Locked reproduction check against Lonial 2005 observed means.

open_questions.question: Whether (1 - slope*C) was bounded at zero.
open_questions.evidence: With C in ng/mL the term is negative above 14.3 ng/mL (myelosuppression) or 2.0 ng/mL (budding). Bortezomib plasma concentrations after a 1.3 mg/m2 IV dose briefly exceed both, which would make production or budding negative, i.e. cell destruction rather than inhibition. The source does not say whether the term was bounded; Phoenix WinNonlin does not bound it by default.

open_questions.question: Value of the circulating platelet loss rate Kcirc.
open_questions.evidence: Figure 1b shows Kcirc separately; no value or rule is given. In the cited base models Kcirc = Ktr (Friberg 2002), which is also required for all compartments to start at the same baseline.
open_questions.resolution: Assumed equal to Ktr; recorded as an assumption.

open_questions.question: Value of the proliferation rate Kprol.
Starting values of each compartment.
open_questions.evidence: Not stated. With Kprol = Kcirc = Ktr the pre-treatment steady state is Prol = Trans1-3 = Circ = Circ0.

open_questions.question: IV bolus or infusion.
open_questions.evidence: 'intravenously (i.v.) twice weekly' only. The bortezomib label describes a 3-5 second IV push.
open_questions.resolution: Treated as bolus; recorded as an assumption.

open_questions.question: Whether the pediatric parameters should have been scaled again.
open_questions.evidence: Supplement S1 states Hanley et al. referenced body size to an average adult, yet the parameters were also scaled from 1.30 to 1.62 m2.
open_questions.resolution: Reproduce as published, because the PD parameters were estimated with this PK model; record as a concern.

open_questions.question: Bortezomib clearance falls after the first dose.
open_questions.evidence: The bortezomib label reports lower clearance after repeated dosing than after the first dose; this linear model has a single clearance.
open_questions.resolution: Reproduce as published; record as a limitation.

limits: Fitted to digitised mean data; typical-value outputs only; no between-patient variability.
Late rises in mean platelet counts may reflect withdrawal of patients with thrombocytopenia (source Limitations).
Myeloma-related thrombocytopenia before treatment is not modelled; it enters only through a low starting count.
No external validation in the source.
